summary: Verified Yandex.Webmaster ownership verification (code f16f1f4b66bcd604) via both methods + full regression. Created /app/backend/tests/test_yandex_verification.py (8 tests). Full backend suite: 26/26 passed. Playwright runtime verification on the public preview URL: yandex meta tag present in <head>, static verification file served with correct body and NOT swallowed by SPA fallback, Metrika (window.ym + mc.yandex.ru/metrika/tag.js) and GA4 (window.gtag + gtag/js?id=G-KGLEKRJCB3) intact, zero console errors, /admin login with token works, lead form submits end-to-end. nginx.conf reviewed. All 6 requested items PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: nginx.conf L78-80 `location / { try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html; }` is correct — .html is NOT captured by the asset regex block (L65 lists only ico|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|svg|woff2?|ttf|otf|eot), so /yandex_f16f1f4b66bcd604.html resolves as a real file from the html root before the SPA fallback. Production behaviour will match preview.

Non-blocking: yandex_f16f1f4b66bcd604.html has no <!doctype html>; this matches Yandex's own generated file format and the crawler only greps the 'Verification: <code>' substring, so no change needed.

Non-blocking: no cache-control header applies to /yandex_*.html in nginx (only /index.html and asset regex get one). Harmless, but adding no-cache would prevent a stale copy if the code is ever rotated.
There is no DELETE /api/leads/{id} endpoint — QA cleanup must go through /app/tests/cleanup_leads.py (direct Mongo). Test file updated to use that instead of a non-existent DELETE call.
